items.title: ‘Responsible, hardworking’ 20-year-old co-pilot among 9 killed when Learjet nosedived into a road
items.brief: In the blink of an eye, a private jet plummeting 450 feet per second nosedived into a Florida roadway, bursting into flames and killing all nine people on board .
